{
  "mode": "CUSTOM",
  "instruction": "**RULES**

- Start the commit message with a brief summary line.
- If only one file was changed, begin the summary line with the filename followed by a colon.
- The full summary line must not be longer than 72 characters.
- Add an empty line after the summary line.
- Avoid overly verbose descriptions or unnecessary details.
- Use short sentences in imperative form that are no more than 140 characters long to describe each change.
- If a description item is longer than 70 characters, write the item in two lines, with a maximum of 70 characters each.
- For each change start on a new line.
- Prefix each line with a "+" for additions, a "-" for removals, and a "#" for fixes.
- Add a space after the prefix and before the description.
- If an item is written in two lines, prefix the second line with two spaces, so the are aligned.
"
}
